title: Someone Left You a Path
excerpt: The best way into a subject is often another person. Search gives you results. A person can give you a path.
seoTitle: Someone Left You a Path | Kahana Library
metaDescription: Search gives results. A Kahana hub is a path someone already walked: files, notes, and a place to start.
content:
The best way into a subject is often another person. Every obsession deserves an entrance.

Search gives you results. A person gives you a path

A results page does not know what to open first. A hub can. Someone has already found the first five things worth seeing, named the files, and left the rest out. Behind every great collection is someone saying, start here.

That is the seeker’s side of Kahana. You are not asked to perform for a feed. You open what a person arranged, save it, and come back. If it helped, you can leave Aura so the next person can find the door. See Kahana for learners.

Knowledge travels further when someone leaves the door open

Creators already do this in captions and comment replies, one fragment at a time. A hub is the same instinct with a front door: the tutorial, the references, the workshop, free or priced. When someone pays, that is the monetary side of the same exchange. They get the path. You get paid for access. Kahana’s fee is 5%.

If you are the person leaving the path, start with one subject you would stand behind. The feed ends here is the creator version of this idea.
